links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses to congenital hypothyroidism patient questions versus recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across all indices (p<0.001); ChatGPT-5.2 had highest FRE and lowest FKGL, Gemini most complex; all models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level.
links.quote: However, all models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level.

links.outcome: Reading level of chatbot patient education text relative to recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: All four chatbots produced text above the recommended sixth-grade reading level; Gemini produced the most complex text; differences across all readability indices p<0.001.
links.quote: However, all models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM responses to patient FAQs regarding congenital hypothyroidism using readability and quality metrics, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
